headline: RapWire 24/7: Five distinct stories — Sept. 24, 2026 — 2 PM Pacific
body: This verified five-slide RapWire news carousel covers five distinct current stories: Tee Grizzley’s They Forgot; Flatbush Zombies’ Felony Ring; 2hollis’ Warhorse; Apollo Brown and Skyzoo’s Luxury Tax; and Rockstar’s GTA 6 Vice City Collection rollout. Each story is separately sourced, visually identified, and labeled with context and attribution.

Each story is separately sourced, visually identified, and labeled with context and attribution.
caption:
1) Tee Grizzley’s new album *They Forgot* is set for Friday, Sept. 25. The Detroit rapper’s seventh studio project lands as one of the week’s clearest full-length rap releases, giving his 2026 run a major next chapter. @TeeGrizzley

2) Flatbush Zombies return with “Felony Ring” on Friday. The Brooklyn trio’s new release arrives in the middle of a packed rap drop date, keeping the Glorious Dead’s psychedelic, crew-minded sound in the conversation. @FlatbushZOMBiES

3) 2hollis is listed for “Warhorse,” a new release scheduled for Sept. 25. The track adds another sharp, left-field voice to a Friday slate that leans beyond straightforward mainstream rap. @2hollis

4) Apollo Brown and Skyzoo reunite for *Luxury Tax*, out Friday. The Detroit producer and Brooklyn MC are following up their decade-old collaboration with a full project built around Brown’s soulful production and Skyzoo’s layered writing. @ApolloBrown @Skyzoo

5) Rockstar’s GTA 6 support hub now points players toward the game’s editions, pre-order support and *The Album* details as the Vice City launch campaign accelerates. Jason and Lucia remain the center of the November 19 console release, with the new collection chatter adding another piece to the rollout. @RockstarGames @TakeTwo

@Rapwire247
